Question: A set \(S\) is constructed as follows. To begin, \(S=\{0,10\}.\) Repeatedly, as long as possible, if \(x\) is an integer root of some polynomial \(a_nx^n+a_{n-1}x^{n-1}\) \(+\cdots+a_1x+a_0\) for some \(n\ge1,\) all of whose coefficients \(a_i\) are elements of \(S,\) then \(x\) is put into \(S.\) When no more elements can be added to \(S,\) how many elements does \(S\) have?
